title: Qwen3.8-Max Launch: Focused on Real Office and Complex Tasks, Model Weights to Be Open-Sourced Next Week

content_html:
Alibaba officially released the new large model Qwen3.8-Max. According to the official introduction of the Qwen large model, the new model has achieved comprehensive upgrades in core capabilities such as programming, real office work, long-term task execution, and multimodal agents, further enhancing the ability to autonomously execute and deliver complex tasks. The model weights are planned to be officially open-sourced next week.

The official stated that Qwen3.8-Max can complete complex and open-ended tasks with minimal human intervention, achieving end-to-end execution from goal understanding, task planning, to final delivery, with enhanced application capabilities of agents in real production environments. This upgrade covers not only code generation and software development scenarios but also further optimizes office automation, multi-step reasoning, and multimodal collaborative processing capabilities, enabling the model to handle more complex practical workflows.

The upcoming open-source of model weights means developers and enterprises can perform secondary development, model fine-tuning, and intelligent agent application building based on Qwen3.8-Max, further promoting the development of the open-source large model ecosystem.

As industry competition gradually shifts from basic model performance to agent capabilities and the efficiency of complex task execution, the release of Qwen3.8-Max further reflects the development trend of large models towards high autonomy, end-to-end delivery, and real business scenario deployment.

content_html_zh:
阿里巴巴正式发布全新大机型Qwen3.8-Max。 据Qwen大模型官方介绍，新模型在编程、真实办公、长期任务执行、多模态代理等核心能力上实现了全面升级，进一步增强了自主执行和交付复杂任务的能力。 该模型权重计划于下周正式开源。

官方表示，Qwen3.8-Max能够以最少的人为干预完成复杂、开放的任务，实现从目标理解、任务规划到最终交付的端到端执行，增强了智能体在真实生产环境中的应用能力。 此次升级不仅涵盖了代码生成和软件开发场景，还进一步优化了办公自动化、多步推理、多模态协同处理能力，使模型能够处理更复杂的实际工作流程。

模型权重的即将开源，意味着开发者和企业可以基于Qwen3.8-Max进行二次开发、模型微调、智能代理应用构建，进一步推动开源大模型生态的发展。

随着行业竞争逐渐从基础模型性能转向代理能力和复杂任务执行效率，Qwen3.8-Max的发布进一步体现了大模型向高度自治、端到端交付、真实业务场景部署的发展趋势。
